verdict.rationale: W&B provides an official MCP server (wandb-mcp-server, docs at platform/mcp-server.md) that gives coding agents like Claude Code direct access to Weave data—traces, evaluations, scorers—enabling them to read production data and run evaluation loops autonomously. This is corroborated by both first-party docs and a dedicated GitHub repo. missing for 10: independent third-party hands-on validation of the MCP server's reliability beyond vendor docs.
